title: refactor: move DreamShaper GPU backend under operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the active DreamShaper worker from image.pollinations.ai/dreamshaper-lcm to operations/infrastructure/gpu/dreamshaper.
- Colocates the active SANA alias topology document with DreamShaper.
- Updates Vast provisioning and fleet inventory references.
- Leaves only the retired SANA-Sprint implementation for the later legacy-cleanup PR.
- Changes no model behavior, routing, credentials, pricing, or live Vast instances.

Operational note:
- Existing DreamShaper workers keep running their currently checked-out files.
- Do not pull this commit into an existing worker checkout by itself: /root/run-dreamshaper.sh points at the old path.
- On a future reprovision or intentional worker update, run setup-vast.sh from the new path so it rewrites the restart command before relying on the new checkout.

Validation:
- DreamShaper unit tests
- operations deployment-detection tests
- shell syntax and Python compilation checks
- stale-path and relative-link checks
- git diff --check

Stacked on #13243.

gist.headline: DreamShaper finds its shed
gist.blurb: The active DreamShaper GPU worker moved into the operations garden, where its provisioning notes and fleet map can live beside it. Same model behavior; tidier soil.
gist.summary: Moved the active DreamShaper worker and its Vast provisioning references from image.pollinations.ai/dreamshaper-lcm to operations/infrastructure/gpu/dreamshaper, with no changes to routing, credentials, pricing, or live instances.
gist.impact: Future DreamShaper reprovisions can use setup-vast.sh from the new operations path, while existing workers continue running their current checked-out setup until intentionally updated.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, carries a labeled DreamShaper server crate from a small image-generation workshop into a cozy garden shed full of organized GPU tools and a fleet map; a code-plant and flowers make the infrastructure move feel calm and orderly.
